signal.title: RF / Signal
signal.subtitle: The signal behind reported receptions.
signal.error: Could not load signal data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
signal.measurement: Signal measured by observers on the last hop. Charts count retained receptions and use UTC time.
signal.window: Window: {{since}} to {{until}} UTC (end exclusive). Complete-hour snapshots refresh in the background; the current hour is excluded. Blank hours do not establish an outage.
signal.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
signal.averagesHelp: Each mean weights every available reception equally. Missing includes absent, invalid and zero/zero unavailable readings; a measured zero SNR remains valid. SNR and RSSI can have different sample counts. These readings do not measure end-to-end quality or packet loss, and colors are not quality thresholds.
signal.binsHelp: Bins include the lower bound and exclude the upper bound. The outer bins include all values beyond the display range. Hourly means below are rounded to one decimal place.
signal.histogramDescription: {{metric}} distribution in {{unit}}. Exact bin boundaries and counts follow below.
signal.trendDescription: Hourly mean {{metric}} in {{unit}}, UTC. Missing readings remain gaps. Exact values are in the hourly table.
signal.coverageDescription: Available and unavailable readings for SNR and RSSI. Exact counts and percentages are in the sample availability table.

paths.subtitle: How received packets carry route hashes.
paths.error: Could not load path data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
paths.measurement: Path entries reported by observers, counted per reception. Hash-width shares use nonempty hash paths.
paths.window: Window: {{since}} to {{until}} UTC (end exclusive). Complete-hour snapshots refresh in the background; the current hour is excluded. Blank hours lack retained records.
paths.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
paths.countsHelp: Flood paths accumulate entries; direct routes contain remaining entries. Empty paths have no hash-width vote. Trace headers carry signal readings. Unclassified records lack usable payload or path metadata.
paths.details: Exact width, path-length and hourly values
paths.lengthsHelp: Length counts include validated ordinary empty paths at zero. In the trend, recorded hours with no hash paths show zero; absent hours remain gaps.
paths.widthDescription: Hash-width share among nonempty ordinary paths. Empty, trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow below.
paths.coverageDescription: Path classification for all retained receptions. The four categories partition the total; exact counts follow alongside.
paths.lengthDescription: Received path entries per reception. Zero means an empty ordinary path. Trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow in the table.
paths.trendDescription: Hourly receptions carrying nonempty 1, 2 or 3-byte hash paths, UTC. Absent hours remain gaps. Exact values follow in the hourly table.

traffic.subtitle: When and where observers report receptions.
traffic.error: Could not load traffic. Try refreshing.
traffic.measurement: Counts are reported receptions, not unique packets. Blank hours have no retained hourly record; they do not establish an outage. Times are UTC and the latest hour may be partial.
traffic.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
traffic.groupingHelp: Charts group smaller areas into “Other IATAs”; this table keeps every area.
traffic.shareDescription: Reception share by IATA. Exact counts and percentages follow in the table.
traffic.trendDescription: Hourly reported receptions by IATA. Gaps mean no retained hourly record. Exact totals follow in the data table.
traffic.heatmapDescription: Activity heatmap by UTC day and hour. Brighter cells indicate more reported receptions; blank cells have no retained record.

scopes.title: Transport scopes
scopes.subtitle: Retained data and memberships for the selected region.
scopes.error: Could not load scopes. Try refreshing.
scopes.measurement: An observer can appear in more than one scope. Global observer counts include stored memberships; regional counts use retained scoped receptions. Nodes are counted in their default scope. These counts have no selected time window.
scopes.groupingHelp: Charts show the largest 12 scopes plus any remainder. The table keeps all matching scopes.
scopes.chartDescription: Counts by transport scope. Exact values for all matching scopes are listed in the table.

observerPage.summaryMissing: Packet summary unavailable on this server. Charts remain available.
observerPage.empty: No packets recorded in this period

observerCompare.title: Compare observers
observerCompare.invalidObserver: Choose a different observer with a valid identifier.
observerCompare.invalidTime: This comparison time is invalid or too old. Refresh to use the latest complete window.
observerCompare.unavailable: Aligned summaries are unavailable. Refresh both observers, or update the server to support shared windows.
observerCompare.currentNote: Activity totals use this shared window. Device values and the latest complete hour describe current conditions; the hour start is shown in UTC.
observerCompare.retention: Raw packet history may expire before the longer-lived activity summaries. Overlap counts only retained flood packets in the shared window, across all regions.
observerCompare.empty: No retained flood packets were reported by either observer in this window.
observerCompare.definition: Each flood packet hash counts once across both observers. Repeat receptions are deduplicated. This is not a packet-loss measurement: expiry, offline devices and broker interruptions affect the available reports.
observerCompare.retainedWindow: Packet details and overlap use retained raw records, so periods older than the server's packet retention come back incomplete.

investigation.title: Observations
investigation.pathNote: Grouped by path prefixes and hash width, not confirmed physical routes. Inspect each report for candidate identities.
investigation.traceNote: TRACE entries describe the intended route, not a measured reception path. Inspect the trace readings separately.
investigation.empty: No retained reports for this packet.
investigation.unmappable: Mapping needs at least two uniquely resolved, valid locations.
investigation.retention: Reports include all received regions and follow packet/observer deduplication, so not every reception or path is retained. Expired reports are unavailable; reported timing does not establish packet loss or delivery.
investigation.unavailableReport: Selected report is unavailable or its identifier is invalid. Choose a retained report below.
investigation.mapNote: Only uniquely resolved locations are shown. Unresolved or unlocated gaps are not connected; lines do not establish direct radio links or delivery.
investigation.unavailableMap: The selected path cannot be mapped from the retained evidence. Choose an available path or All paths.

routeEvidence.title: Retained reports
routeEvidence.invalidPath: Invalid shared path. Open the route again to use its current representation.
routeEvidence.invalid: Invalid shared time window. Choose a range to continue.
routeEvidence.missing: The saved route or evidence API is unavailable on this server.
routeEvidence.error: Could not load retained reports. Try again.
routeEvidence.match: Matches the complete saved prefix sequence at {{width}} byte(s) per hop. Other widths, subsegments, TRACE and unclassified reports are excluded.
routeEvidence.caution: Matching bytes are not proof of the same physical route. Hop names are the saved route identities; inspect each packet for its candidate matches.
routeEvidence.retention: These are retained reports, not distinct packets or the route’s lifetime count. Reports can expire while the saved route remains. The time window ends at the exclusive UTC boundary shown above.
routeEvidence.unavailable: The saved prefixes cannot be used to match retained reports.
routeEvidence.empty: No retained reports match this saved prefix sequence in this window. History may have expired or used a different prefix width.
routeEvidence.cap: Showing up to 500 reports. Choose a shorter window to narrow the investigation.
routeEvidence.legacy: Retained report links need a server that supplies stable route keys.
routeEvidence.brief: Prefix matches, not confirmed physical routes. Raw reports may expire.
routeEvidence.definition: How these reports are matched and counted

atlas.subtitle: Your nodes, at a glance.
atlas.name: Name
atlas.searchHelp: Search all regions. Enter at least two characters; a public key uses hexadecimal characters.
atlas.limitReached: All {{limit}} card spaces are in use. Remove a card to add another.
atlas.noMatches: No matching nodes. Try a different name or key.
atlas.refine: Showing the first eight matches. Refine your search to find more.
atlas.localOnly: Saved in this browser · All regions
atlas.storageFailed: Browser saving is unavailable. Your changes work for this visit but may not be kept.
atlas.emptyTitle: Build your own view of the mesh
atlas.emptyDescription: Find a repeater, companion or other node above and add a card. Your selection and card order will be here when you return.
atlas.refreshFailed: Refresh failed; showing the last loaded sample.
atlas.nodeUnavailable: This saved node could not be loaded. It may have expired or the server may be unavailable.
atlas.activityLabel: {{count}} received reports in the loaded {{range}} sample. Hourly values are available under Statistics.
atlas.sample: Loaded sample · up to {{limit}} recent reports
atlas.noReports: No retained reports in this window. This does not establish whether the node is offline.
atlas.latestAdvert: Observers of the latest loaded packet
atlas.heardUnavailable: The packet details are unavailable or have expired. Try another retained packet from the node profile.
atlas.definition: Each report is one stored packet reception originating from this full node key, using server deduplication. These are sampled reports, not a total of all node traffic. Blank bars mean no loaded reports; older raw history may have expired.
atlas.signalDefinition: Signal meters average available last-hop measurements at the receiving observers. They do not measure the originating node’s radio health. The hourly bars use a rolling window, ending now.
atlas.capped: More reports exist than this card loads. Counts and averages cover only the loaded sample.

topology.title: Mesh Pulse
topology.canvas: 3D mesh topology. Drag or use arrow keys to orbit; plus and minus to zoom; Home to fit. Use Find a node for keyboard selection.
topology.controls: Drag to orbit · pinch or scroll to zoom
topology.bounded: This view is bounded to 2,000 nodes, 5,000 links and 2,000 recent reports. A limit was reached; focus a region to see more local detail.
topology.gap: Live coverage has a gap after pausing, backgrounding or reconnecting.
topology.noNodes: No matching nodes in the loaded view.
topology.definition: Nodes are grouped by their most recently heard IATA, not their geographic position. Grey lines are stored first-hop neighbour relationships, without a selected time window. Moving colours show adjacent hops resolved to one known identity in live reports; gaps and ambiguous prefixes are never joined. Motion illustrates the path, not measured radio travel time or delivery. Live counts are packet/observer pairs received in this browser during the last 60 seconds, deduplicated within that window; hidden or paused time is not backfilled. Up to 64 paths animate at once. The finder searches loaded nodes. Refresh updates the node snapshot.
topology.noCatalogue: No MeshMapper source configured for this IATA.
topology.catalogueMeaning: Regional counts only; not proof that these neighbours forward each scope. ◉ = monitored, including zero-count names.
topology.cataloguedLink: Listed in a regional MeshMapper catalogue; not per-link forwarding evidence.
